atoms.text: When browsing the internet, it is important to protect your data. If your data is tracked, this can lead to sensitive information such as passwords or account details being hacked. Strangers then might have access to your e-mails or bank account.

atoms.text: Before you type in information on a website you should pay attention to the internet address. The connection is safe when it starts with https. The “s” means secure.

instruction.text: Entscheide, ob die Aussagen wahr oder falsch sind.

atoms.a: A website with “https” is more secure than a website with “http”.

atoms.text: When you open a website you will be asked which cookies you want to allow the website to use.
atoms.sound: When you open a website you will be asked which cookies you want to allow the website to use.

atoms.text: Cookies are small pieces of information that are being sent to your browser by the website you visit. They are used to track your data and browsing behaviour. This results not only in customized ads on websites but also in the browser having information about your location, clicks, shopping preferences, search history or device specifications.

atoms.text: Some cookies are necessary for the internet to work properly. However, it is generally recommended that you accept as few cookies as possible to protect your data.
